summary: The code matches the call and branch, but misses the binary's evaluation order and named member requirement.
issues: P-code tests param_1 bit 0 before writing to this; the reversed code writes first. This can differ if this aliases the parameter's storage.
The write at offset 0 uses a raw cast instead of a named struct member.
fix_instructions: Compute the bit-0 condition before assigning the pointer, then branch on the saved result after the assignment.
Define the object's offset-0 pointer member and assign &PTR_FUN_00715d0c through that member.
